title: Alexander–Whitney tensor cochain map for cosimplicial module sheaves
statement: For any cosimplicial module sheaves A,B,C on a scheme X and natural pointwise tensor morphism mu from A tensor B to C, the total tensor of the zero-extended alternating coface complexes of A,B admits a cochain map to the corresponding complex of C. On the (0,0) summand it is mu in degree zero, conjugated by the extension identifications. There are no flasqueness, exactness, or augmentation hypotheses.

source.place: Banerjee, Tensor Structure on Smooth Motives, §1.1.4, p. 16, Alexander–Whitney formula and (1.1.2); applied to the additive tensor structure of module sheaves.

proof.text: Use the explicit front/back component construction. Its coproduct descent recovers the formula on each bidegree and its zero-zero summand equals the given degree-zero pairing.

Build a CochainComplex.ofHom from those components. Check commutation by mapBifunctor.hom_ext. For r,s nonnegative use the signed AW summand identity and the tensor total differential formula, proved directly from mapBifunctor.d_eq, ι_D₁, ι_D₂, d₁_eq and d₂_eq. If either r or s is negative, its extended term is zero, tensoring preserves zero objects, and equality holds because the common source is zero.
Supply the constructed cochain map as witness. The coproduct summand identity and the proved zero-zero calculation give exactly the requested restriction at degree zero.

theorem moduleCup_cosimplicial_aw (X : Scheme.{u}) [MonoidalPreadditive X.Modules]
    (A B C : CosimplicialObject X.Modules) (μ : moduleCup_cosimplicialTensor X A B ⟶ C) :
    ∃ t : HomologicalComplex.tensorObj (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X A)
        (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X B) ⟶ moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X C,
      HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X A)
        (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X B) 0 0 0 (by simp) ≫ t.f 0 =
        moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroPair X A B C μ
